review.reason: Integrated C1+C2+C3 cross-source reconciliation feature, adding one additive read-only endpoint: GET /api/data/reconciliation (latest multi-source cross-check summary: per-fund verified/mismatch/unverified/source_unavailable status, NAV point coverage/agreement, critical failures, warnings, and per-field source values). Diff vs pre-feature baseline 582feb8 adds exactly 1 operation and 3 schemas (DataReconciliationReport, FundReconciliationView, ApiResponse_DataReconciliationReport_) with zero breaking hints; no existing operation, field, constraint, response code, or required parameter changed. The write gate itself adds no endpoint and only enforces reconciliation before staging for online sources.
